summary_en: TOA Corporation resolved to acquire up to 4.5 million shares (5.67% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of JPY 8.0 billion through market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 20, 2026 to March 24, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled on March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
TOA Corporation's board of directors approved a share buyback programme on November 10, 2026. The company will acquire up to 4.5 million of its ordinary shares, representing 5.67% of issued shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026 (79.43 million shares outstanding). The maximum acquisition amount is JPY 8.0 billion. Purchases will be made through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 20, 2026 and March 24, 2027.

All shares acquired under this programme will be cancelled on March 31, 2027. The company stated that the buyback aims to sharpen capital-conscious management, enhance shareholder returns, and improve capital efficiency while maintaining awareness of cost of capital and share price levels.
